description: The provided donut chart, titled “Win rate (%)”, visually represents the comparative performance of three large language models—GPT-4o, GPT-4o (again, but with a different value), and LLaMA—based on their win rates in a specific evaluation context, likely from the paper “Distilling Empathy from Large Language Models”. Notably, the chart appears to list GPT-4o twice with different percentages, which may indicate two different configurations, evaluation conditions, or potentially a labeling error. A gray legend entry is present but unlabeled, suggesting either an omitted category or a placeholder. The segments are arranged clockwise, with LLaMA dominating the chart, visually emphasizing its superior performance in this metric. The central white circle contains the chart’s title, and percentage values are explicitly labeled for each segment, enhancing clarity.
